description: This is a Java test class for the MultiSelectionAddOnsBrowserFragment, using Robolectric for Android unit testing. It contains multiple test methods verifying UI components and menu options related to the add-ons browser fragment.

classes.name: MultiSelectionAddOnsBrowserFragmentTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the UI and behavior of the MultiSelectionAddOnsBrowserFragment in various configurations.

methods.name: getStartFragmentNavigationId
methods.description: Returns the navigation ID used to start the fragment.

methods.name: testNoDemoKeyboardViewAtRoot
methods.description: Verifies that the demo keyboard view is null at the root view.

methods.name: testNoDemoKeyboardViewInLandscape
methods.description: Verifies that the demo keyboard view is null in landscape configuration.

methods.name: testNoListShadow
methods.description: Checks that the list shadow view is null.

methods.name: testNoListShadowInLandscape
methods.description: Checks that the list shadow view is null in landscape configuration.

methods.name: testJustRecyclerRoot
methods.description: Verifies that the root view is a RecyclerView.

methods.name: testJustRecyclerInLandscape
methods.description: Verifies that the RecyclerView is present in landscape configuration.

methods.name: testHasTweaksAndMarket
methods.description: Checks that menu options for tweaks and market are present and have correct visibility states.
